decision.title: DTD validation is an optional feature; the core size audit (packet )
decision.summary: DTD validation becomes the optional feature "dtd-validation", which removes the XSD schema compiler from the core sxml.wasm; without it the dtd-validation option raises FODC0013.

body.p: , after , , , , . The core sxml.wasm was 2,294,051 bytes stripped (801,273 gzipped) at 7fac033, over 's 2,200,000 / 770,000, so javascript/size_budget failed.

item.p: What grew it (linker maps of the core module, code and data, from 8d19cbf, 's 2,121,086 / 739,785): 4869814 (fn:doc and fn:parse-xml dtd-validation, ) +167,419. The processor's document loader called sxml_dtd_validator_create, which compiles the schema documents written from the DTD, so the whole XSD schema compiler became reachable: schema_read 55,036, schema_content_model +27,304, schema_simple_type 19,178, schema_complex_type +18,546, schema_resolve 10,019, schema_assemble 8,556, schema_components +4,972, schema_assertion +3,725, schema_identity +2,457, schema_from_dtd 1,707, data +11,552. ffccefa (fn:put and revalidation, ) +4,267: xquery_update_apply +3,043, the rest of XQuery Update through the lowering registry (). 01a3993 (EXSLT, ) +1,279: function_library_exslt 1,080. a7e7e38 and eb1e397: 0. No HTML or other feature was linked by mistake; XPath 1.0 compatibility mode was already in 's number.

Moved: DTD validation becomes sxml_dtd_validation_feature() (include/sxml/schema.h, additive; name "dtd-validation"; kind SXML_OPTIONAL_FEATURE_KIND_DTD_VALIDATION; definition and operations table in src/schema_from_dtd.c, its type in src/dtd_internal.h). The loader (src/processor.c, sxml_loader_parse_with_dtd) reaches the validator only through the table. Without the feature the dtd-validation option raises FODC0013, F&O 4.0's error for a processor without a parser for the requested options (17.1.1, 17.2.1; its note names web browsers): the option's single place. sxml_all_optional_features() includes it, so the sxml command, the QT4, XSLT and XSD drivers and sxml-full.wasm keep DTD validation. The public sxml_dtd_validator API is unchanged: a host that calls it links it.

Kept in the core: reading the DTD, internal and external entities, attribute defaults and normalization, is-id and is-idrefs (src/xml.c, src/xml_entity.c); src/dtd.c (9.5 KB, the DTD written as schema documents) stays linked, because the parser calls it through the validator interface of the frozen xml.h. Schema validation for fn:xsd-validator stays ('s choice), as do the XQuery lowering parts of the registry (: about 75 KB, a registry split, not a feature).

System properties: supports-dtd-validation and supports-dtd-attribute-typing (F&O 4.0, 17.1.9; true since ) follow the feature: a value kind OPTIONAL_FEATURE in src/system_property_internal.h, answered by sxml_processor_find_optional_feature, as the KNOWN_FUNCTION properties follow their features' functions.

Sizes (stripped / gzipped -9): sxml.wasm 2,294,051 / 801,273 to 2,128,754 / 741,943, under 2,200,000 / 770,000 with no budget raised (7,668 bytes over 's module: XQuery Update 3,624, the loader's DTD and trust-external code 1,536, EXSLT 1,080); 2,131,859 / 742,980 at 384a2e8 with 7.16's timezones. sxml-full.wasm 3,577,133 / 1,108,707, the CLI module 6,079,521 / 1,323,861.

Counts (release drivers, all features configured; the same before and after): QT4 fn-doc XP40 67, XQ40 73 of 75; fn-parse-xml XP40 42, XQ40 53 of 57; fn-doc-available 34 of 47; fn-system-properties 23 of 35; fn-id XP40 30, XQ40 61 of 61; fn-idref XP40 24, XQ40 51 of 54; XT40 document 83 of 99. No XSD code changed, so no XSD set was run.
